title: HB 1727 (107th General Assembly): As introduced, allows student attending a state university to use student identification card as evidence of identification. - Amends TCA Title 2, Chapter 7.
operative_text:
(a_in_person_id)
(section) 2-7-112 (new subsection, unnumbered)
(quote) Notwithstanding any other provision of this section to the contrary, a student attending a state university may use their student identification card as evidence of identification.
(b_no_id_remedy) not stated.
(c_mail_ballot_id) not stated.
(d_proof_of_citizenship) not stated.
(e_other_rule) not stated.
(other) Section 2: effective on becoming law.
(other) version: 180586-Draft (2011-02-17): student-ID subsection (slot a), with Senate companion SB1381 in header.
(other) version: 524506-Draft (2011-12-10): identical body text (same size, only header/placement differences); no change.
(other) note: Died in House State & Local Government Committee 2011-03-08. LegiScan's motion line reads 'recommended for passage' while the action log says 'Failed In'; the voice vote has no tally, so read the action log for the outcome. Does not say whether the card must carry a photo. Slot a only; no remedy, mail, or citizenship text.
